name: 4-FPP
summary: A piperazine derivative that has been reported to have mild pyschedelic effects and empathogenic qualities. It has been sold in many branded legal highs.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It has also been shown to inhibit the reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine, and to possibly induce their release. Metabolic studies have shown pFPP to be an inhibitor of various Cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver which may contribute to its side-effect profile.

uses.text: It has been sold as an ingredient in legal recreational drugs known as "Party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world.
